_: Every piece of painted interface art the game loads (godot/src/Ui/UiArt.cs), with where it goes, the size of the file (twice the size shown, for 4K), its nine-slice margins in shown pixels, how it is cut, and a prompt to start from. Read by tools/comfy/ui_art.py; specified in docs/UI_ART_BRIEF.md.
style: Dark fantasy video game user interface asset, front orthographic view, centred on a pure black background, hand-painted forged blackened iron with thin inlaid gold filigree, worn and battle-scarred, soft light from the upper left, AAA game UI art in the style of Diablo IV and Hades, crisp edges, no text, no letters, no numbers.
